== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Snapjaw Windshell]] ([[Archipelagos]])

== Notes ==
* You gain energy and health from this skill’s own overcast cost.
* You can quickly build up overcast to a useful amount by activating and [[cancel]]ing this skill a few times.
* This spell takes fractional points of overcast into account. For example, if you cast this skill while you’re not otherwise overcast, you will gain 5 points of overcast as you start casting it. By the time you finish casting it, you will have already regenerated {{1/3}} points of overcast and this skill will give you only 4 energy and 23 health, not 5 energy and 25 health.
* It takes 15 seconds to fully recover from this skill’s overcast cost and maintain a stable level of overcast. When cast every 15 seconds, this skill gives the equivalent of 1 [[pip|pip of energy regeneration]] for every 5 points of overcast. For ease of calculation and because fractional points of overcast aren’t visible in the user interface, this table ignores the {{1/3}} point of overcast lost during this skill’s activation time.
